stages.name: PHP core RCE exploitation
observables: unauthenticated HTTP request targeting PHP worker (php-fpm, mod_php, php-cgi)

scenario.summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in PHP core (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) allow attackers to gain code execution in the context of web worker processes. Post-exploitation involves web servers spawning shells for system discovery, staging second-stage payloads via interpreters, and establishing persistence through webshells or system configuration.

meta.rationale: Prioritize Linux servers running external-facing PHP applications. If the software inventory is outdated, run the hunt unscoped to capture all web workers.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker has exploited a PHP core vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618/109619) and is using the web worker context to harvest credentials or establish persistence via reverse shells and web shells.

hunt.name: Post-RCE Persistence and Credential Theft
hunt.description: This hunt targets the post-exploitation objectives of the php2shell vulnerabilities. It specifically examines web worker processes (php-fpm, apache2, nginx) for convergent malicious behavior: accessing cloud credentials, environment files, or instance metadata, and spawning interactive shell primitives like netcat or socat. The hunt uses a parallel fan-out to analyze file activity and process execution across multiple surfaces, identifying rare or unauthorized actions originating from the web stack.

nodes.label: Web worker access to credentials and persistence

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_path, activity_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{web_worker_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{web_worker_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{credential_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_path) || ',') > 0 OR (activity_id = 1 AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.php' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.phtml' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%avatar.php.jpg'))) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, file_path, activity_name HAVING host_count <= 5
config.description: Identify web workers reading credential files or writing new PHP/phtml files.
config.expected_signal: A web worker process accessing sensitive files or creating new PHP scripts on a small subset of hosts. Normal application behavior should be widespread and excluded by the prevalence check.

nodes.label: Web worker spawning shells and network tools

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{web_worker_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{web_worker_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(actor_process_name) || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{reverse_shell_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR process_cmd_line LIKE '%/dev/tcp/%' OR process_cmd_line LIKE '%pty.spawn%' OR process_cmd_line LIKE '%fsockopen%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify web workers spawning shell primitives or redirection tools used for interactive access.
config.expected_signal: A web worker spawning netcat, socat, or shell primitives. This is a high-confidence signal of post-exploitation command-and-control.
